name: Jahid Hasan Rony
title: Lecturer, Researcher
subtitle: BSc, MSc in CSE, DUET
bio:
I am a postgraduate researcher in Computer Science and Engineering, interested in understanding how AI can understand visual information more efficiently.

My research focuses on deep learning and image processing; more into semantic segmentation, with a particular interest in lightweight model design. I completed my B.Sc. (2023) and M.Sc. (2026) from Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology, Gazipur (DUET), Bangladesh, where my master's thesis explored efficient segmentation models for image analysis (Link to my Paper Published in Nature). Previously, I have worked as a Research Assistant at Independent University, Bangladesh, contributing to projects in medical imaging, UAV-based image analysis, and deep learning-based segmentation. I also enjoy teaching and explaining technical ideas in a simple way. 

Currently, I am looking for PhD opportunities where I can continue learning, contribute to meaningful research, and grow as an independent researcher.
